title: A course pack's procedure puzzle (courses/<id>/puzzles/<name>.json)
description: A procedure with a dry run: aim, preview, check, then run it for real. The crane's targets (berths), its spare names, the cargo it lands, the command and the readout's tones. A puzzle the course runs has its mechanic's fields; a `"disabled": true` file needs none. Every puzzle file has an `id`, its `mechanic`, and may set `disabled` (the site stays as scenery), `text` (its words by key, `{name}` filled in by the game) and `lines` (its voice line ids by what they're for). docs/specs/COURSE-PACKS.md §4.

disabled.description: The course turns this puzzle off: its site stays as scenery and its cue does nothing.

text.description: The puzzle's words by key (labels, hints, readouts, signs).

lines.description: Voice line ids (voice/lines.json) by what they're for.
